title: Father's brass band playing
summary: His father played in brass bands only, taught the sons, and died around 1931 at 54.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: Oh yeah, I know where that is. I'm black on the side of the floor. Were you a family musical at all? Uh huh. Your family musical. Oh my brother never played with you. Oh yeah. Oh my people played with my dad. He played with old Pickford family. What instrument?
That's called Melancholy. And who? Did he play any in the dance orchestras? String bands?
No, it was brass bands. Just brass bands? Yes, he taught us to play brass bands.

When did he die? Or is he still alive? My daddy died around 1931. And how old was he when he died? He was 54 years old. Uh huh. 54. Was he an ear man or a reader or both? No, he was playing a band. He was a player. But he didn't fake it all? No, he was reading them 6-8-Modges. Oh yeah, that's it.
